item.text: Inspecting the reconstructed JSON for the registrant name, then I’ll return the exact one-line answer.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import json
path='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/BESTBUY_2023_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(path) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
for i,item in enumerate(data.get('texts',[])[:80]):
    txt=item.get('text','').replace('\\n',' ')
    if any(k in txt.lower() for k in ['registrant','exact name','commission file number','irs employer','state of incorporation']):
        print(i, item.get('page_no'), repr(txt[:500]))
PY"
